environment.description: Celery worker running on ECS Fargate with task role arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/NotificationWorkerRole. Redis is ElastiCache (no AUTH). Worker environment has AWS credentials via task metadata endpoint (169.254.170.2). Jobs are submitted via SQS by the API layer which accepts user-defined templates. No template sandboxing beyond the basic blocklist. Worker has network access to internal services and metadata endpoint.
